steps.content: Concealed by camouflage and cover, Broken Blade Squad 3 runs through their final pre-battle checks.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: You're telling me the enemies outside are just a distraction, and their real force is hiding inside the ash storm? No one can last more than a few hours in that kind of intensity.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: If their Aurum Secretum wielders can do it, so can we. And the Chief needs us to scout ahead.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: The shackles are still detecting the Sinner captured by BR-005. We can use them to guide us straight to that Black Ring. It's a viable strategy.
The doctor lets out a sigh.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: HA? Him again? That bookish guy collapses three times a day like clockwork. And he's supposed to command under fire? You really think that's gonna work?
steps.female_content: HA? Her again? That bookish lady collapses three times a day like clockwork. And she's supposed to command under fire? You really think that's gonna work?

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Strengthening the shackle connection now will only speed up his contamination. Typical of our acting commander, always pushing it. Let's just hope he doesn't burn out before the battle's over.
steps.female_content: Strengthening the shackle connection now will only speed up her contamination. Typical of our acting commander, always pushing it. Let's just hope she doesn't burn out before the battle's over.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Our only focus is the mission.
After sending the final message to Nirvana Port, the man takes out a flare gun.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Our mission objectives are clear: penetrate deep into the Tide of Ashes and locate the enemy's main force. Minos will maintain comms and provide guidance. If possible, destroy any Aurum Secretum device we encounter. This will weaken their control over the Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: These are the commander's orders. And Augustus's orders.
After confirming the direction ${PlayerName} indicated, he fires the signal flare as promised, marking the beginning of the operation.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Broken Blade Squad 3, move out. Complete the mission. Eliminate all resistance until victory.
